en: The postcard features a printed black-and-white image of an elegant multi-story house, identified as 'Haus Bathildis' in Bad Pyrmont, Germany. Accompanying the house image is detailed German text promoting the guesthouse's location, amenities, and service, mentioning its proximity to the region's spa and health facilities. The reverse side includes address details, official stamps, and museum markings, along with handwritten notes.
